capabilities: Track daily word counts across all vault notes
Show writing streaks, average daily word count, and usage stats
Publish selected notes to a public profile in real time
Resolve embedded note references and strip HTML comments before upload
Compete on a shared leaderboard across multiple vaults
extras: The plugin sends anonymized behavioural data (word counts, installed plugin list) to YourPulse servers; Private Mode, activated with a license key, keeps everything offline. Publishing is marked per note via a yp-publish frontmatter property. More details at YourPulse.cc.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track writing activity over time or share selected notes and stats on a public profile.

relations.evidence: Supports rendering of Dataview queries within your notes

summary: Writing activity tracker that counts daily words across the vault, shows streaks and stats, and publishes selected notes to a public profile.
